RICHARD NIXON

The White House,

August 21, 1972

Revoking Executive Order No. 5221 of November 11,1929, establishing 
a limitation on non-official employment of officers or employees of 
the American Government

the American Government”, is hereby revoked.
T h e W h i t e H o u s e,
